_metadata.description: License allowlist/denylist policy for all AI-SDLC projects. Used by the license CI gate in all pipeline scaffolding and verified during SOC Review (Step 5).
_metadata.review_cadence: Quarterly or on any new SPDX license addition to the ecosystem

denied.description: These licenses impose copyleft obligations that are incompatible with proprietary Mahindra software. Any dependency using these licenses MUST NOT be introduced. Violation = pipeline FAIL and Critical SOC finding.

warned.description: These licenses may impose redistribution or attribution requirements. Permitted for use but require legal team awareness. Flag in SOC Review — document justification in SECURITY.md.

allowed.description: Permissive licenses approved for use in all Mahindra AI-SDLC projects without restriction. No additional legal review required.

exceptions.description: Specific package-level overrides, approved by CISO + Legal. Each entry requires a justification and expiry date. Do NOT add entries here without written CISO approval.

ci_integration.pipeline_gate: Block on any denied SPDX ID match; warn on warned list; pass on allowed list; unknown = warn + open legal review ticket
ci_integration.report_artifact: license-report.json (upload as CI artifact per pipeline run)
